content:
SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure in adults with reduced ejection fraction.

- **Dapagliflozin**: the primary outcome occurred in 16.3% of patients versus 21.2% with placebo, *hazard ratio 0.74* [1].
- **Empagliflozin**: 19.4% versus 24.7%, hazard ratio 0.75 [2].
- **Sotagliflozin** lowered the event rate after worsening heart failure (51.0 versus 76.3 events per 100 patient-years) [3].

Cardiovascular death alone was not clearly reduced in the trial of mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction (`HR 0.88`, 95% CI 0.74 to 1.05) [4], so most of the benefit comes from fewer hospitalizations for heart failure [1][2].
